# Synthetic fixture for the epistemic checks' tests: invented, nothing from a customer.
Ceph OSD writes fail with ENOSPC when OSD debug logging is left raised
Environment
An OpenShift cluster running Rook-managed Ceph OSDs.
Issue
An OSD logs "no space left on device" writing its log under /var/lib/rook.
Root cause
`debug_osd` was left at 20/20 after a troubleshooting session.
The OSD's log grew until the filesystem holding /var/lib/rook was full.
Resolution
Set `debug_osd` back to its default, then remove the OSD's rotated logs.
